GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , got back 2nd last rails 6 Lengths 700m, worked to Middle Of Track and better ground Straightening Up , kept grinding away but never close enough # grinding effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn , Held Up home turn then taken off heels Straightening Up , shifted 3 Wide at 200m, ran on hitting joint Lead in the final stride # DH/got up on line
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running rounding the home turn until inside the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Stayed same until improviing slowly on inside from 500m. Pushed to quicken Two Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 300m & chased soundly Two Wide in last 200m. # Honest effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unable to improve rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to chase Four Wide @ 400m. Chasing Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Presured Six Wide @ 200m & worked home OK in last 200m. # Sound last 200m.

Jumped ok off the rails gate settled down fifth 4 Lengths (700m), easing to the Outside for home called upon, stuck to task running into third Without threat (Cross-over Nose Band AGAIN, Tongue Tie OFF AGAIN) # stuck to task
Jumped Well Settled Down 5th 3 Lengths 600m 5th 3 Lengths Straightened Up 5th Kept Going Ok Straight # average/fair run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 850m was steadied after improving into restricted room inside heels. Rounding the home turn was buffeted between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out pushing on crossed & led comfortably (1000m), joined before Turn & headed off into the Straight although rallying, Under Whip 200 soon spent, faded out of it (Visors AGAIN, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # led/spent 200
Little Slow Out Ridden Along Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths checked off heels x 750m lost 1 Lengths now 7th, in Clear Straightening Up couldn't finish off (v/off w/1st) # bother @ 750m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Buffeted on jumping away. Near the 800m, had to be checked from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Les Bridge) Jumped well landing second balanced up behind Leader fence 2 Lengths (800m), urged for home room to come through as Leader skipped Clear , Under Whip battled soundly (Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME, Visors FIRST TIME) # sound/stuck to task
Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1.5L off all clear, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 50m shifted out and became unbalanced when contacted on the hindquarter by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 3 Wide 4th 3 Lengths off leader/winner Out On A Limb , Under Pressure x 400 couldn't quicken gone x 100m, (rider said too keen early/midrace) # 3 wide, caved in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and made contact. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Rdr reported the filly raced fiercely in the early and middle stages and as a result, was left without a finishing effort. A post race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 6th 6 ; within 4 Lengths x 500 Straightening Up 5th Outside Ridden Along kept trying without threatening (t/t/off) # kept on behind
